nhce01.title: First Snow Text
nhce01.caption:
Your crush texts "it's snowing!!" and you freeze. Reply now or play it cool?
Neither. Send a snow photo back. Being happy to hear from them is allowed.

nhce02.title: The Borrowed Scarf
nhce02.caption:
They lent you their scarf. Is it a promise or just a scarf?
You won't know by guessing. Ask what it means.

nhce03.title: The Plus-One
nhce03.caption:
The party invite says "plus one?" Who do you bring?
Not someone to impress the room. Bring someone who'd actually enjoy the night.

nhce04.title: Single in Cuffing Season
nhce04.caption:
Cuffing season started and you're single. Panic-date or hide till spring?
Neither. Cozy counts with your friends, too.

nhce05.title: The Three-Week Gift
nhce05.caption:
Three weeks in and the holidays are here. What's the gift?
Not a whole tree, not nothing. Something small and sweet says plenty.

nhce06.title: Two Weeks Apart
nhce06.caption:
They're going home for two weeks. Tag along or go silent?
Pick a call time you both like, then go enjoy your own people.

nhce07.title: Too Cold to Go Out
nhce07.caption:
Too cold to go out tonight, and you had plans.
Don't brave it in no coat, and don't cancel with "lol". Call and stay in together.

nhce08.title: The Winter Playlist
nhce08.caption:
They made you a winter playlist. How do you answer that?
Not with nine hours of your own, and not with "nice". Tell them the song you replayed.

nhce09.title: Drew Your Crush
nhce09.caption:
Gift exchange, and you drew your crush.
Skip the big spend and the mystery pen. Get the thing they mentioned once. It shows you listened.
